<script lang="ts">
  import ProductList from './ProductList.svelte';
  import ProductDetail from './ProductDetail.svelte';
  import NotFound from './NotFound.svelte';
  import { products, type Product } from './products';

  function normalize(p: string): string {
    if (p.length > 1 && p.endsWith('/')) return p.replace(/\/+$/, '') || '/';
    return p;
  }

  let path = $state(normalize(window.location.pathname));

  $effect(() => {
    const onPop = () => {
      path = normalize(window.location.pathname);
    };
    window.addEventListener('popstate', onPop);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('popstate', onPop);
  });

  function navigate(to: string) {
    if (normalize(to) !== path) {
      window.history.pushState({}, '', to);
    }
    path = normalize(to);
    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
  }

  type Route =
    | { name: 'home' }
    | { name: 'product'; product: Product }
    | { name: 'notfound' };

  let route: Route = $derived.by(() => {
    if (path === '/') return { name: 'home' };
    const match = path.match(/^\/productos\/(\d+)$/);
    if (match) {
      const id = Number(match[1]);
      const product = products.find((p) => p.id === id);
      if (product) return { name: 'product', product };
    }
    return { name: 'notfound' };
  });
</script>

<main class="max-w-xl mx-auto p-6 font-sans">
  {#if route.name === 'home'}
    <ProductList {products} {navigate} />
  {:else if route.name === 'product'}
    <ProductDetail product={route.product} {navigate} />
  {:else}
    <NotFound />
  {/if}
</main>

<script lang="ts">
  import ProductList from './ProductList.svelte';
  import ProductDetail from './ProductDetail.svelte';
  import NotFound from './NotFound.svelte';

  type Product = { id: number; name: string };

  type Route =
    | { name: 'home' }
    | { name: 'product'; product: Product }
    | { name: 'notfound' };

  const products: Product[] = [
    { id: 1, name: 'Mesa' },
    { id: 2, name: 'Silla' }
  ];

  function normalize(p: string): string {
    if (p.length > 1 && p.endsWith('/')) {
      const trimmed = p.replace(/\/+$/, '');
      return trimmed === '' ? '/' : trimmed;
    }
    return p;
  }

  let path = $state(normalize(window.location.pathname));

  $effect(() => {
    const onPop = () => {
      path = normalize(window.location.pathname);
    };
    window.addEventListener('popstate', onPop);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('popstate', onPop);
  });

  function navigate(to: string): void {
    if (to !== window.location.pathname) {
      history.pushState({}, '', to);
    }
    path = normalize(to);
    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
  }

  const route: Route = $derived.by((): Route => {
    if (path === '/') return { name: 'home' };
    const m = path.match(/^\/productos\/(\d+)$/);
    if (m) {
      const product = products.find((p) => String(p.id) === m[1]);
      if (product) return { name: 'product', product };
    }
    return { name: 'notfound' };
  });
</script>

<main class="max-w-xl mx-auto p-6 font-sans">
  {#if route.name === 'home'}
    <ProductList {products} {navigate} />
  {:else if route.name === 'product'}
    <ProductDetail product={route.product} {navigate} />
  {:else}
    <NotFound />
  {/if}
</main>
